verdict.rationale: Discord ships official, well-documented REST and Gateway APIs, OAuth2, webhooks, and an official 'Embedded App SDK' for building apps/games inside Discord, and a live probe confirms the REST/Gateway endpoints are functional. However, there is no evidence of a first-party general-purpose SDK library (e.g., official Python/JS SDK) for building bots/agents—only REST/Gateway primitives and the narrower Embedded App SDK for in-client experiences. missing for 10: official first-party bot/agent SDK library, broader language coverage, independent hands-on confirmation of SDK usage beyond raw API probes.
